title: Uninstall cannot remove machine-wide light hooks or the global skill yet
text: Machine uninstall reverts every harness setting recorded in the machine home's harness-settings-written.json and removes Yoke's machine-wide hooks from every harness's user config, with their Codex trust, through its own machine-wide hooks step. The yoke-global skill does not exist yet; when it lands it must record its writes in that file so uninstall removes it.
